name: YTL Power International Berhad
summary: YTL Power International Berhad operates as a multi-utility owner and operator in Malaysia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Power Generation, Water & Sewerage, Telecommunications, Data Center; and Investment Holding Activities. The Power Generation segment engages in the generation and sale of electricity; tank leasing; bunkering; and sale of fuel oil, steam, natural gas, and water. The Water & Sewerage segment supplies water; and provides wastewater treatment and related services.
